name: Red teaming
summary: azure-ai-evaluation RedTeam: attacker/scorer are Microsoft-managed; only the TARGET model accepts BYOM.
description: The Azure AI Evaluation `RedTeam` target can name the model under test as `{connection}/{deployment}`. This routes adversarial probe generation against a BYOM-backed target so users can red-team a gateway-hosted model deployment.
notes:
Verified that the RedTeam target model accepts a BYOM-prefixed deployment name. See `test.py`.

Live proof against `ai-foundry-63fhh7glaqhvw`: `azure-ai-evaluation[redteam]` accepts `{apim-conn}/{model}` at `RedTeam` object initialization. The test is thin: it does not run a full adversarial scan; it proves SDK acceptance of the BYOM-prefixed deployment name.
